preconditions.description: The number of books is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
Each book title has at least 1 and at most 10^3 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s_i) == m for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each book title has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_i) for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each character in a book title is an uppercase Latin letter.
All book titles are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is a valid book index.

postconditions.expression: output == sorted(range(1, n+1), key=lambda i: [s[j] if j % 2 == 0 else s[j] for j in range(m)])
postconditions.description: The output is the indices of the strings sorted asc-desc-endingly.
